mentions.h: RESULT OF BOYS AND YOUTHS MEDAL COMPETITION - 1959

mentions.note: won 880 yds (2:14.7 off 15 yds) and 100 (11.5 off two yards)
5th long jump, 18'6", open field events meeting
18.12.44 - 22.08.88; joined 1954; 880 yards best 1:52:2 at 1965 Surrey Championships; Maccabiah Games 800m silver; Cambridge University AC secretary; won Club Championships 1974 in 1:54.7

share.d: Dave Wiseman in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1959–1991: 7 mentions in 6 issues and 5 race results.
